column1: # Y Combinator job board slices: role slug <TAB> place slug (blank = no place).
# Read by `jobsweep sweep` after queries.tsv; one plain HTTP GET each, ~40 rows.
# Only the places YC itself lists filter anything — an unknown slug (warsaw,
# poland, barcelona) is refused by the sweep rather than read as a random
# sample. Checked 2026-09-26: remote, europe, london, berlin, amsterdam, paris,
# dublin, munich and lisbon filter. Most rows are US-only; `shortlist` and
# `publish` drop what cannot be done from Poland.
